name: decision_kind
description: Which kind of standing choice this decision is; each kind has its own frame.

aiGuidance.purpose: Optional. The kind of promise the decision makes about the future. Choose one. A kind is worth having only while it differs from the others in how the decision is framed or reviewed; if two kinds read the same in practice, merge them.
aiGuidance.extraction: Frames, one per kind. purpose: "We exist to X, for Y." Reviewed when each new epic is tested against it. boundary: "X covers A, not B." Reviewed when work keeps landing on the edge. premise: "We work as if X." A belief held true enough to act on. Reviewed when practice keeps contradicting it. preference: "X over Y, unless Z." Reviewed when the unless-case keeps firing. A preference decision ratifies a method principle record rather than restating it. policy: "Every X must Y; measured by I." Reviewed by the indicator each cycle. design: "We model X as Y, because principle P." Reviewed at the next case of the same pattern. mandate: "Group G may X within M." Reviewed at each report. See docs/decision-log.md in the clerk.
